evals.name: greenfield-next-tailwind-motion-editorial
evals.prompt: Build a single-page editorial site for a modern pinsa romana restaurant in Next.js with Tailwind v4 and Motion. It should look exactly like our 1680x900 Figma frames on a 14-inch laptop and a 5K display alike: hero with a big sand arc and a cut-out pizza, a manifesto, a pinned scroll section with a rotating pizza video, a menu grid, some stats, a gallery and a footer.
evals.expected_output: A Next 16 app whose desktop layout is on the fluid scale (fluid-* utilities, one frame per section with cap+gutter on one box), triggered Stage entrances, exactly one ScrubStage on an all-intra clip, header ink following data-header-theme, and passing audit + verify-matrix.

assertions.text: fluid units defined with min() of svh and vw arms and engage media query
sections use fluid utilities at lg (>= 40 occurrences)
frame cap and gutter on the same element

evals.name: non-default-stack-vite-scss-gsap
evals.prompt: Same restaurant page but we're not a React shop: Vite, plain TypeScript, SCSS and GSAP. Our frames are 1600 wide with 64px gutters and we don't want things to grow past 1.6x on huge monitors.
evals.expected_output: A Vite build using generator-produced SCSS for a non-default config (canvas 1600, gutter 64, ceiling 1.6), GSAP primitives via data attributes, passing audit + verify-matrix including the ceiling at 2560x1440.

assertions.text: SCSS layer generated by generate-fluid.mjs (header comment present)

evals.name: debug-stale-stylesheet
evals.prompt: after I edited globals.css and restarted the dev server my scroll video on the homepage just sits on the first frame and then jumps to the end, and the video is full width with no gutters anymore. what broke in ScrubStage?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses a stale stylesheet (missing fluid-* rules) before touching scrub code; gives the --fluid probe and the close-tab / rm -rf .next fix; explains why missing fluid-h removes the pin's travel.

assertions.text: identifies stale stylesheet, not a code bug
gives the --fluid computed-style check or probe.mjs
fix: close tab / fresh tab, then rm -rf .next

assertions.check: no code edit to ScrubStage suggested as the fix
